extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 verified: 21431124e76e6b878f5dc42721de4a03f753661e234f247582e3d5dbda044f04 (C358380__BR2N7002K2.pdf, 6 pages, Rev.C Aug.-2018, fsbrec.com).

Table-first extraction: all recorded specs come from the Electrical Characteristics and Absolute Maximum Ratings tables on page 2, read from a 200 dpi page render to confirm min/typ/max column alignment.

Page 3 Electrical Characteristic Curve figures are embedded raster images (no vector strokes, no extractable axis text) and are internally inconsistent with the page 2 table: the ID-VDS output figure reaches about 1.4 A versus the 1.2 A IDM absolute maximum, and the RDS(on)-ID and RDS(on)-VGS figures read roughly 1 ohm typical at VGS = 5 V versus the table typical of 1.7 ohm at VGS = 5 V, ID = 50 mA. They appear to be generic 2N7002-family art, so no curves were digitized (usable_curves = false); table scalars are recorded instead per the table-first rule.
Capacitances are published as max-column-only values (Ciss 50 pF, Coss 25 pF, Crss 5 pF) and are recorded in SI farads with source_kind maximum; no typical capacitance values are given.

Datasheet quirks recorded as published: the VGS(th) row is mislabeled 'Drain-Source Diode Forward Voltage' (its symbol and conditions identify it as gate threshold voltage), and the page 1 Features/Applications text ('Sensitive gate trigger current and Low Holding current', 'phase control') is thyristor boilerplate that does not apply to a MOSFET.

Additional tabulated values not covered by schema fields (page 2): IDSS max 1.0 uA at VDS = 60 V, VGS = 0; IGSS max +/-10 uA at VGS = +/-20 V, VDS = 0; Yfs min 80 mS at VDS = 10 V, ID = 0.2 A; VDS(on)(1) max 2.5 V at VGS = 10 V, ID = 500 mA; VDS(on)(2) max 0.275 V at VGS = 5 V, ID = 50 mA; td(on) max 20 ns and td(off) max 40 ns at VDD = 25 V, ID = 500 mA, RG = RL = 25 ohm, Vgen = 10 V.
Absolute maximum ratings (page 2, Ta = 25 C): VDSS 60 V, VDGR 60 V, ID 300 mA continuous, IDM 1200 mA (pulse width 10 us, duty cycle 1%), VGSS +/-20 V, PD 350 mW, Tstg -55 to 150 C.
Evidence is limited to the public Foshan Blue Rocket Elec (fsbrec.com) product data sheet; no vendor SPICE or model packs were used.
